mapper.sql: id, username, password, name, idcard, phone, address, avatar, level, parent_id, quota, status, profile_done, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status != 'deleted'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_user(id, username, password, name, idcard, phone, address, avatar, level, parent_id, quota, status, profile_done, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{idcard}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{avatar}, #{level}, #{parentId}, #{quota}, #{status}, #{profileDone}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_user SET name=#{name}, idcard=#{idcard}, phone=#{phone}, address=#{address}, profile_done=#{profileDone} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET avatar=#{avatar} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET password=#{password} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET parent_id=#{parentId}, level=#{level} WHERE id=#{id} AND parent_id IS NULL
UPDATE cms_user SET quota = quota + 1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET level=#{level} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET quota=#{quota} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE cms_user SET quota = quota - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND quota > 0
UPDATE cms_user SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE parent_id=#{parentId} AND status != 'deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_user WHERE parent_id=#{parentId} AND status != 'deleted'
SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE status != 'deleted' ORDER BY level ASC, created_at DESC
SELECT FROM cms_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE status != 'deleted' AND level=#{level} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE status != 'deleted' AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%') OR id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%') OR username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%')) ORDER BY level ASC, created_at DESC
SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE status != 'deleted' AND created_at >= #{from}
SELECT FROM cms_user WHERE status != 'deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{n}
